caption: Figure 1: A typical cloud gaming system. The congestion controller adjusts both frame bitrates and packet pacing rates before transmit- ting game frames from the gaming server to the end device.

templates.why_chosen: A literal Internet cloud icon is the network boundary between two dashed, mirrored Client and Server boxes, with one orange Congestion controller and its two red control-signal labels the only asymmetry in a symmetric pipeline.
templates.what_to_learn: Draw the network as a literal cloud icon between two mirrored, dashed-outline client/server boxes with matching internal module counts, and make the one contributed component (the Congestion controller) the only differently-coloured box; add a small legend for that colour, since this figure's green-vs-orange split otherwise goes unexplained.
